title: Pure mental events are distinct from brain events

statements.text: Mental life is a succession of pure mental events: patterns of color in the visual field, pains, thoughts, intentions. A subject has a way of knowing them, experiencing them, that no one studying behavior or brain has, and they contain no publicly accessible event, so they are distinct from brain events. A Martian who knew everything happening in a human brain could still wonder whether the human feels anything.

sources.quote: Consequently, they must be distinct from brain events, or any other bodily events.
It is a further fact beyond the occurrence of brain events that there are pains and after-images, thoughts, and intentions.
